label: Late original phase / <DEL> step, boosted when sequence starts with d/w/b/u
explanation: Positional feature that fires at absolute steps t>=4 through the <DEL> step (t<=L). It is silent at t=0-1, almost silent at t=2-3, and nearly silent in the copy phase except a weak tail at recall_idx 0-1. Within the original phase its firing rate rises with t (orig_idx 8: 37%). The <DEL> step carries 35% of the mass (rate 37%). The window alone, (t>=4)&(t<=L), covers 92% of mass but precision is only 0.29. Activation is graded and depends strongly on the first original token: d (3.7x lift), w, b and u give the largest activations, and every top example starts with d, w or b. Restricting the window to first tokens d/w/b/u/q/s/0/c raises precision to 0.65 and loses recall (dev F1 0.58, mass recall 0.62). Low-level firing also occurs for other first tokens, which this predicate misses. It responds more to first occurrences of a token (in_first) and is unaffected by digit count or copy correctness.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the first original token (most: d, w, b, u, 0, q; least: t, x, j, 1) and the second original token (most: d, f, w, 0, c, l; least: k, m, j, t); timing cues that raise it most: t=6, t=7, t=5.
